Read input: mg_00300_combined.v · Open raw
module mg_00300 (input clk400,input clk80,input reset,input enable,input sdata,output reg [4:0]pdata,output reg error);
reg [5:0]s; 
  reg detect; 
  reg [2:0]c; 
  wire sync = c[2]; 
  reg [4:0]p; 
  reg e; 
  always @(posedge clk400 or posedge reset) 
  begin 
  if (reset) 
  begin 
  s <= 0; 
  detect <= 0; 
  c <= 0; 
  p <= 0; 
  e <= 0; 
  end 
  else if (enable) 
  begin 
  s <= {s[4:0],sdata}; 
  detect <= (s[5:0] == 6'b100000) || (s[5:0] == 6'b011111); 
  if (sync || detect) c <= 3'd0; else c <= c + 3'd1; 
  if (sync) p <= s[5:1]; 
  if (sync) e <= 0; else if (detect) e <= 1; 
  end 
  end 
  always @(posedge clk80 or posedge reset) 
  begin 
  if (reset) 
  begin 
  pdata <= 5'd0; 
  error <= 0; 
  end 
  else if (enable) 
  begin 
  pdata <= p; 
  error <= e; 
  end 
  else 
  begin 
  pdata <= 5'd0; 
  error <= 0; 
  end 
  end 
 endmodule
